cleaning.why: mortgages & gifts are not market prices

anomalies.note_weekday: Before 2022 Sunday was a working day in Dubai, yet the file has zero Sunday transactions and Monday has ~2x the volume of any other weekday: Sunday registrations appear folded into Monday. We therefore never analyse below monthly granularity.

rules: 1. Keep 2015-01-01 .. 2026-09-17 (same window as Parts 1-2; earlier years are
sparse and include implausible dates such as 1967). 2026 is a partial year:
counts are annualised x1.404 where a yearly volume is compared.
2. Keep trans_group 'Sales' only: mortgages and gifts are not market prices.
3. Keep residential Units and Villas (usage = Residential); land/buildings have
price >= AED 100,000 (removes zero/symbolic and implausible values).
5. Robust statistics only (medians, quantiles); bootstrap CIs for uncertainty.
